examples.label: The loop
examples.command: # Scope -> Scan -> Evaluate -> Interpret -> Remediate -> Rescan

notes:
Steps: identify/analyze risk -> set scanning policies -> configure (targets, ports, protocols, aggressiveness, timing) -> scan -> evaluate risk -> interpret results -> remediation/mitigation plan.
Scan types: network, host-based, wireless, application.
Risk model: Risk = Threat x Vulnerability. Assess by Likelihood x Impact (ISO 31000).
Start from an asset inventory (on-prem, cloud, SaaS, apps, network devices).

recommended.note: Pick a scanner for the assessment.

name: Reference - Vulnerability Assessment Methodology
description: The structured VA process and the risk model that drives prioritization.
